status.$description: Light-mode semantic STATUS roles — success / warning / info, each paired with its on-color. Distinct from the core role set in color.light.tokens.json: those roles map onto whatever native color-role table a platform provides, whereas these three have no universal native slot and bind into the platform's theme-extension mechanism (DESIGN.md §2). `error` is deliberately NOT here — it is a core role with a native slot on every target. Dark mode lives in color.status.dark.tokens.json.

info.$description: Informational status. Neutral, not chromatic — consistent with the monochrome-by-design thesis (DESIGN.md §2): info is not an alert, so it carries no hue.
